title: Newsletter signup: error message is not read out after submitting an invalid email

description.summary: Submitting the newsletter form with an invalid email address shows a red message, but nothing was announced while using a screen reader.
description.actual: A red error message appeared near the email field, but the person using a screen reader was not told an error occurred.

affected_people.description: A person who uses a screen reader
affected_people.scope_limit: Based on one person's report; the specific screen reader and browser were not provided.

impact.effect: The person did not know why the form did not submit or what to fix.

manual.rationale: The report has not yet been reproduced by the team.

testing_with_disabled_people.rationale: Not yet determined whether this warrants dedicated participant testing; the underlying error-announcement pattern is well understood and can likely be verified through manual evaluation first.
